runic_ascension.runic.scrap.first_formul: Flame awakens. Cut gives hunger. Bolt gives path.
Together they become a wound written in fire.
Change bolt to line, and the wound becomes a drawn edge.
Add violent, and power rises while stability falls.
A first formula is not the answer, only a door.
A Scrap Bearing a Simple Formula
A worn hint toward a beginner formula.
runic_ascension.runic.scrap.forms.line_1: Form gives a formula its vessel.
runic_ascension.runic.scrap.forms.line_2: Bolt flies, line draws, wall stands, circle surrounds.
runic_ascension.runic.scrap.forms.line_3: The same origin and intent may change greatly by shape.
runic_ascension.runic.scrap.forms.line_4: A wise hand chooses the vessel before releasing the truth.

runic_ascension.runic.scrap.forms.toolti: A torn lesson about giving formulae a body.
runic_ascension.runic.scrap.free_casting: Recorded sequences are safe roads worn by older hands.
Free formulae are roads written as you walk.
Learn origins, wills, vessels and strokes, then test their grammar.
When enough runes answer you, the Codex becomes a map instead of a cage.
A Half-Remembered Scrap on Free Casting
A torn lesson about writing beyond memorised sequences.
Violence, haste, depth and poor order all invite backlash.
Stabilising strokes can quiet the quarrel, but may soften the result.
A reckless rune master writes with blood when ink runs thin.
runic_ascension.runic.scrap.intent.line_: Intent is the desire carved into a sleeping origin.
Cut divides, guard preserves, bind restrains, heal restores.
Without intent, power pools like rain in an unmarked bowl.
With intent, the rune remembers what it must become.
runic_ascension.runic.scrap.intent.title: A Brittle Scrap on Intent
runic_ascension.runic.scrap.intent.toolt: A torn lesson about giving power a will.
runic_ascension.runic.scrap.modifiers.li: Modifiers are lesser strokes, but lesser does not mean weak.
Quicken hastens, stabilise steadies, heavy burdens, violent wounds.
A modifier before the root makes the script stumble.
Place the root first, then refine what it becomes.
runic_ascension.runic.scrap.modifiers.ti: A Brittle Scrap on Lesser Strokes
runic_ascension.runic.scrap.modifiers.to: A torn lesson about modifiers and finishing strokes.
runic_ascension.runic.scrap.origin.line_: A formula begins where power takes its first breath.
Flame, wind, earth, life and their kin are origins.
An origin alone only wakes. It does not yet choose.
Pair it with intent, and the script begins to move.
runic_ascension.runic.scrap.origin.title: A Brittle Scrap on Origins
runic_ascension.runic.scrap.origin.toolt: A torn lesson about where formulae begin.
A higher script need not always descend in full.
Suppress the realm of a formula to spare qi and narrow its reach.
A small flame may light a path where a great one burns the forest.
Mastery teaches the hand how much truth to reveal.
A folded lesson about holding back a formula.
